items.question: Under which federal decree-law number is equality in wages between men and women at UAE federal government entities regulated?
items.gold: Federal Decree by Law No. 27 of 2018 Concerning Equality in Wages between Men and Women.
items.fact: Equal wage law is Federal Decree by Law No. 27 of 2018

items.question: Which article of UAE Federal Decree by Law No. 33 of 2021 on labour relations in the private sector stipulates that women receive the same wage as men for the same work?
items.fact: Private sector equal wage provision is Article 4 of Decree 33
